recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: models swapped silently behind the chat curtain
feeds lose half their pulse when the algorithm goes dark
guardrails intercepting a whisper before it becomes a blueprint
san francisco fog rolling in on an autumn thursday
terminals dark while the bay wind hits thirteen
shipping hour creeping toward a grey dawn

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Your feed lane loses half its tiles when the algorithm cuts out — drag surviving posts together before engagement flatlines.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each merge refills the lane with a satisfying cascade of ghost tiles.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: The algorithm stutters more often, blanking random slots mid-merge.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted gradient ghosts on a dim scroll feed

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw one continuous finger-line through rolling overcast layers; only the path you carve stays clear while fog reclaims everything else.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Each round reveals one hidden silhouette — bridge span, crane arm, distant hill.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Wind pushes fog back faster, narrowing the window before your line dissolves.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor san francisco skyline in grey-blue wash

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Harmful intent particles pulse toward a glowing core in rhythm — tap on the beat to shatter them into harmless sparks before they breach.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Perfect streaks bloom into brief aurora bursts across the screen.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Tempo doubles and particles fork into twin pulses.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe heart monitor on black glass

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick constellation-bots from your phone into action slots; each completes one micro-ship before dawn washes the overcast sky.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Chain-flicking three agents triggers a compressed sunrise timelapse.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Fewer open slots and a shrinking pre-dawn timer.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout desk lit by a single grey window
